;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]], [[Ghazni offensive]]
**A large-scale military offensive is launched by the [[Taliban]] in a bid to overrun the southeastern city of [[Ghazni]], a provincial capital on the [[Kabul–Kandahar Highway]]. They manage to take control of a part of the city. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/11/world/asia/afghanistan-taliban-ghazni.html (''The New York Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Colombia]]
**[[Colombia]] announces its withdrawal from the [[Union of South American Nations]] after having suspended its membership in the organization since April 2018. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2018/08/10/colombia-dejara-de-ser-miembro-de-unasur/ (CNN)]
*[[Turkey–United States relations]], [[2018–2021 Turkish currency and debt crisis]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] authorizes the doubling of [[Trade Expansion Act|Section 232]] tariffs on imports of aluminium and steel from [[Turkey]], to 20% and 50% respectively. The [[Turkish lira]] further falls to a new record low against the [[U.S. dollar]] and Turkish stocks tumble. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/08/10/turkish-lira-loss-deepens-as-pm-erdogan-calls-for-citizens-to-convert-.html (CNBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Fredericton shooting]]
**At least four people, including two police officers, are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Fredericton]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45146056 (BBC)]
*[[Glyphosate|Glyphosate § Legal cases]]
**A jury in the U.S. state of [[California]] awards $289 million to a man who claims that his terminal cancer was caused by [[Monsanto]]'s [[glyphosate]]-containing weed killer. [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-us-canada-45152546 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Horizon Air Q400 incident]]
**An airport mechanic steals a [[Horizon Air]] [[Bombardier Q400]] from [[Seattle–Tacoma International Airport]] in the United States, eventually crashing the plane on [[Ketron Island, Washington|Ketron Island]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/seatac-stolen-plane-crash-horizon-air-alaska-airlines-seattle-today-2018-08-10/ (CBS News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2017–2018 Romanian protests]]
**452 people are injured in clashes between protesters and police during an anti-government meeting in [[Bucharest]], [[Romania]]. [https://stirileprotv.ro/stiri/actualitate/protestul-diasporei-primele-masini-cu-protestatari-au-sosit-inca-din-timpul-noptii-in-piata-victoriei.html (Știrile Pro TV)]
*[[United Nations Development Group]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations General Assembly|General Assembly]] confirms [[Michelle Bachelet]], former [[President of Chile]], to succeed [[Zeid Raad Al Hussein]] as the [[UN High Commissioner for Human Rights]]. The decision to appoint her for a four-year term, starting September 1, was made by [[Consensus decision-making|consensus]] after her nomination by [[UN Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]]. [http://tass.com/world/1016846 (TASS)]
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**Lewis Ludlow pleads guilty to financing and planning a terrorist van attack in [[London]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-45147682 (BBC)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Costa Rica]] rules that a ban on [[same-sex marriage]] is illegal, and states that legislators must change the law accordingly within eighteen months. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-45138687 (BBC)]
